hooks.command: p="$(/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,sys;print((json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input") or {}).get("file_path",""))' 2>/dev/null)"; case "$p" in *.py|*.js|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.ts|*.tsx|*.jsx|*.sh|*.bash|*.zsh|*.gs|*.go|*.rb|*.php|*.java|*.swift|*.sql) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph update --skip-flows --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || true

cat >/dev/null || true; command -v code-review-graph >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && code-review-graph status --repo "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" || echo 'Not a git repo, skipping'
